title: A Variation Norm Carleson Theorem Along the Primes
abstract: A Lean 4 formalization of the two main theorems of Fragkos, Krause, Miheisi and Sun, A Variation Norm Carleson Theorem Along the Primes. For finitely supported f on the integers, consider the modulated sums S_λ f(x) = Σ_{n ≠ 0} f(x − n) Λ(|n|) e(λn)/n, with Λ the von Mangoldt function and e(t) = exp(2πit). Theorem 1.3: for every r > 2 the r-variation of S_λ f(x) over λ in [0, 1) is bounded on ℓ^p(ℤ) for c(r) < p < C(r), where r' < c(r) < 2 < C(r), c(r) → 1 and C(r) → ∞ as r → ∞. Theorem 1.4: the supremum of |S_λ f(x)| over λ in [0, 1) is bounded on ℓ^p(ℤ) for every 1 < p < ∞. The results of other papers that the proofs use are proved in the repository, among them the variation norm Carleson theorem on the real line (Oberlin, Seeger, Tao, Thiele, Wright), the Magyar–Stein–Wainger transference principle for variation norms and the U³ approximation of the von Mangoldt function; none is assumed. The U³ approximation is proved here from the classical zero-free region and the absence of Landau–Siegel zeros, a Lean proof vendored from the openai/math library.
